  --hl-surf-4:rgba(27,30,36,.55);
  --hl-surf-5:rgba(27,30,36,.5);
  --hl-surf-6:rgba(27,30,36,.65);
  --hl-surf-7:rgba(27,30,36,.7);
  --hl-veil:rgba(18,19,22,.7);
  --hl-solid-1:#101114;
  --hl-solid-2:#0d0e11;
  --hl-solid-3:#16171c;
  --hl-mark:rgba(235,238,255,.72);
  --hl-mark-soft:rgba(235,238,255,.28);
  --hl-hair:rgba(197,184,255,.35);
  --hl-chip:rgba(255,255,255,.03);

  color:var(--hl-text-01); font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:16px; line-height:1.65;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; text-align:left;
}
/* the shell toggles <html class="dark|light">; treat "not dark" as light so a
   shell that simply drops the class still renders correctly */
html:not(.dark) .hlx{
  --hl-bg-01:#fff; --hl-bg-02:#f0f1f7;
  --hl-text-00:#15171f; --hl-text-01:rgba(20,22,31,.9); --hl-text-02:rgba(20,22,31,.7);
  --hl-brand-00:#7657ff; --hl-brand-01:#6244e0; --hl-brand-03:#8a70ff;
  --hl-line-00:rgba(24,22,31,.2); --hl-line-01:rgba(24,22,31,.12); --hl-line-02:rgba(24,22,31,.08);
  --hl-white-04:rgba(0,0,0,.03); --hl-white-08:rgba(0,0,0,.06);
  --hl-ok:#1f9d6b; --hl-warn:#a86a15; --hl-stop:#c2445f;
  --hl-shade:rgba(0,0,0,.12);
  --hl-surf-1:rgba(255,255,255,.86);
  --hl-surf-2:rgba(255,255,255,.93);
  --hl-surf-3:rgba(255,255,255,.7);
  --hl-surf-4:rgba(240,241,247,.6);
  --hl-surf-5:rgba(240,241,247,.55);
  --hl-surf-6:rgba(255,255,255,.72);
  --hl-surf-7:rgba(255,255,255,.76);
  --hl-veil:rgba(255,255,255,.8);
  --hl-solid-1:#eceef4;
  --hl-solid-2:#e6e8f0;
  --hl-solid-3:#e9ebf3;
  --hl-mark:rgba(20,22,31,.72);
  --hl-mark-soft:rgba(20,22,31,.26);
  --hl-hair:rgba(24,22,31,.32);
  --hl-chip:rgba(0,0,0,.035);
}
.hlx *,.hlx *::before,.hlx *::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
.hlx img,.hlx video{display:block;max-width:100%}
.hlx a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.hlx ul,.hlx ol{list-style:none}
/* entrance + reveal, CSS only: no scroll library, native scrolling untouched */
.hlx .reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);transition:opacity .8s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1),transform .8s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1)}
.hlx .reveal.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.hlx .hero-copy>*,.hlx .fan-card,.hlx .stage-caption,.hlx .arena-eyebrow,.hlx .podium-card{animation:hlxRise .9s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1) both}
.hlx .hero-copy>*:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.08s}
.hlx .hero-copy>*:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.16s}
.hlx .hero-copy>*:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.24s}
.hlx .hero-copy>*:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.32s}
.hlx .fan-1{animation-delay:.20s} .hlx .fan-2{animation-delay:.34s} .hlx .fan-3{animation-delay:.48s}
.hlx .stage-caption{animation-delay:.9s}
.hlx .arena-eyebrow{animation-delay:.45s}
.hlx .podium-card:nth-child(1){animation-delay:.55s}
.hlx .podium-card:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.68s}
.hlx .podium-card:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.81s}
.hlx .podium-card:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.94s}
@keyframes hlxRise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes hlxFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-14px)}}
.hlx .fan-card{will-change:transform}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .hlx .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none}
  .hlx .hero-copy>*,.hlx .fan-card,.hlx .stage-caption,.hlx .arena-eyebrow,.hlx .podium-card{animation:none}
}
.hlx img,.hlx video{max-width:100%;display:block}
.hlx a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.hlx ul,.hlx ol{list-style:none}
.hlx h1,.hlx h2,.hlx h3{font-family:var(--font-display);line-height:1.18;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.hlx .visually-hidden{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}
.hlx .container{max-width:var(--content-max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 32px}
.hlx .side-logo{margin:20px 0;display:flex;height:32px;width:100%;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.hlx .side-items{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;width:100%;padding:0 8px;flex:1}
.hlx .side-item{position:relative;margin:0 4px;min-width:64px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding-bottom:4px;font-size:12px;font-weight:300;line-height:16px;
  color:var(--hl-text-02);border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;
  transition:background .3s,color .3s;white-space:nowrap;}
.hlx .side-item:hover{background:var(--hl-bg-02);color:var(--hl-text-00)}
.hlx .side-item .ic{margin-top:8px;height:24px;width:24px}
.hlx .side-item .lb{margin-top:6px}
.hlx .side-item .tag-hot{position:absolute;top:-8px;right:-6px;pointer-events:none;
  font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:12px;line-height:16px;
  color:var(--hl-brand-03);}
.hlx .side-item .tag-h3{position:absolute;top:-9px;left:36px;pointer-events:none;
  display:flex;align-items:center;height:20px;padding:0 8px 0 6px;
  border-radius:6px;background:var(--hl-brand-00);color:#fff;
  font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:12px;line-height:16px;}
.hlx .side-item .tag-h3 img{width:12px;height:12px;margin-right:2px}
.hlx .side-sep{display:flex;height:9px;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;align-self:stretch;padding:4px 20px}
.hlx .side-sep i{display:block;height:1px;width:24px;background:var(--hl-line-01)}
.hlx .side-bottom{width:100%;padding:10px 8px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.hlx .side-sale{width:72px;cursor:pointer;text-align:center}
.hlx .side-sale .sale-num{display:block;color:var(--hl-text-00);font-size:12px;font-weight:500;line-height:22px;margin-top:-14px;position:relative}
.hlx .side-sale .sale-ultra{color:var(--hl-brand-01);font-size:12px;display:block}
.hlx .side-api{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:12px;font-weight:300;color:var(--hl-text-02);transition:color .2s}
.hlx .side-api:hover{color:var(--hl-text-00)}
.hlx .side-api img{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.hlx .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  font-family:var(--font-body);font-weight:600;font-size:15px;
  padding:11px 26px;border-radius:var(--radius-pill);
  border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s,background .2s,border-color .2s;}
.hlx .btn svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.hlx .btn-primary{background:var(--hl-brand-00);color:#fff}
.hlx .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--hl-brand-03);box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(118,87,255,.45);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.hlx .btn-ghost{border-color:var(--hl-line-00);color:var(--hl-text-01);background:transparent}
.hlx .btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--hl-brand-01);color:var(--hl-text-00);background:var(--hl-white-04)}
.hlx .btn-lg{padding:14px 34px;font-size:16px}
.hlx .hero{position:relative;padding:44px 0 64px;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
.hlx .hero-aurora{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-2;overflow:hidden}
.hlx .hero-aurora span{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(90px);opacity:.5;will-change:transform}
.hlx .hero-aurora .a1{width:640px;height:640px;left:-180px;top:-240px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(118,87,255,.5),transparent 65%)}
.hlx .hero-aurora .a2{width:560px;height:560px;right:-160px;top:60px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(219,46,215,.28),transparent 65%)}
.hlx .hero-aurora .a3{width:520px;height:520px;left:30%;top:340px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(129,115,255,.24),transparent 65%)}
.hlx .hero-grid{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;
  background-image:linear-gradient(var(--hl-line-02) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,var(--hl-line-02) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:56px 56px;
  mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 70% at 42% 30%,#000 25%,transparent 78%);
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 70% at 42% 30%,#000 25%,transparent 78%);}
.hlx .breadcrumb{display:flex;gap:8px;font-size:13px;color:var(--hl-text-02);margin-bottom:30px}

  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}

.hlx .hero-ctas{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:30px}
.hlx .spec-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.hlx .spec-chips li{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;

.hlx .hero-stage{position:relative;height:520px}
.hlx .hero-stage .stage-glow{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:130%;height:80%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(118,87,255,.28),transparent 65%);

.hlx .fan-card{position:absolute;width:min(46%,240px);aspect-ratio:3/4;
  border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid var(--hl-line-00);
  box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.55),0 0 0 1px rgba(118,87,255,.10);
  background:var(--hl-bg-02);will-change:transform;}
.hlx .fan-card video{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.hlx .fan-card::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(200deg,rgba(129,115,255,.14),transparent 42%);

.hlx .fan-1{left:2%;top:10%;transform:rotate(-9deg);z-index:1}
.hlx .fan-2{left:29%;top:2%;transform:rotate(1deg);z-index:3;width:min(50%,258px)}

@media(max-width:1080px){.hlx .hero-stage{height:400px}.hlx .fan-1{left:6%}.hlx .fan-3{right:4%}}
@media(max-width:560px){.hlx .hero-stage{height:320px}.hlx .fan-card{width:44%}.hlx .fan-2{width:48%}}

.hlx .podium{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;align-items:stretch}
.hlx .podium-card{position:relative;border-radius:var(--radius-card);

  background:linear-gradient(140deg,rgba(129,115,255,.55),rgba(219,46,215,.25),transparent 60%);
  filter:blur(10px);opacity:.55;}

.hlx .stat-note{position:relative;z-index:1;text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--hl-text-02);margin-top:32px}
@media(max-width:820px){.hlx .podium{grid-template-columns:1fr;align-items:stretch}.hlx .podium-card.rank1{order:-1}}

  background:radial-gradient(420px circle at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,0%),rgba(118,87,255,.14),transparent 60%);
  transition:opacity .3s;pointer-events:none;}

  padding:12px 6px;background:rgba(118,87,255,.06);}
.hlx .asset-stats b{display:block;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:26px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.1;
  background:linear-gradient(120deg,#8173ff,#db2ed7);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
.hlx .asset-stats span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--hl-text-02)}
.hlx .sound-visual{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;margin-top:auto;padding-top:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hlx .eq{display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:flex-end;height:36px}
.hlx .eq i{display:block;width:5px;border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8173ff,#db2ed7);height:40%}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.hlx .eq i{animation:eqb 1.15s ease-in-out infinite}.hlx .eq i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.12s}.hlx .eq i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.24s}.hlx .eq i:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.36s}.hlx .eq i:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.48s}.hlx .eq i:nth-child(6){animation-delay:.6s}.hlx .eq i:nth-child(7){animation-delay:.72s}}
@keyframes eqb{0%,100%{height:28%}50%{height:100%}}
.hlx .ratios{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.hlx .ratios span{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  border:1px solid var(--hl-line-00);border-radius:6px;
  font-size:10px;color:var(--hl-text-02);background:var(--hl-white-04);}
.hlx .r219{width:46px;height:20px}
.hlx .r169{width:38px;height:22px}
.hlx .r11{width:26px;height:26px}
.hlx .r916{width:18px;height:32px}
.hlx .badge-1440{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:700;font-size:13px;color:var(--hl-brand-01);
  border:1px solid var(--hl-line-00);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 12px;
  background:rgba(118,87,255,.1);}
.hlx .examples{background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,var(--hl-surf-4) 18%,var(--hl-surf-4) 82%,transparent)}
.hlx .rail-wrap{position:relative}
.hlx .rail{display:flex;gap:20px;overflow-x:auto;
  scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;
  padding:6px 6px 18px;
  scrollbar-width:none;}
.hlx .rail::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.hlx .rail-card{position:relative;flex:0 0 clamp(240px,26vw,320px);aspect-ratio:3/4;
  border-radius:var(--radius-card);overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid var(--hl-line-02);background:var(--hl-bg-02);
  scroll-snap-align:start;cursor:pointer;
  transition:transform .35s,border-color .35s,box-shadow .35s;}
.hlx .rail-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:var(--hl-line-00);box-shadow:0 22px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.5),0 0 0 1px rgba(118,87,255,.18)}
.hlx .rail-card video{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.hlx .rail-card figcaption{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;
  padding:44px 18px 16px;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600;font-family:var(--font-display);

        <p>Advanced motion generation that reads your photo and gives it a routine.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="bento">
        <article class="bento-card reveal">
          <div class="bento-icon"><svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="brain-circuit" class="lucide lucide-brain-circuit"><path d="M12 5a3 3 0 1 0-5.997.125 4 4 0 0 0-2.526 5.77 4 4 0 0 0 .556 6.588A4 4 0 1 0 12 18Z"></path><path d="M9 13a4.5 4.5 0 0 0 3-4"></path><path d="M6.003 5.125A3 3 0 0 0 6.401 6.5"></path><path d="M3.477 10.896a4 4 0 0 1 .585-.396"></path><path d="M6 18a4 4 0 0 1-1.967-.516"></path><path d="M12 13h4"></path><path d="M12 18h6a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v1"></path><path d="M12 8h8"></path><path d="M16 8V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2"></path><circle cx="16" cy="13" r=".5"></circle><circle cx="18" cy="3" r=".5"></circle><circle cx="20" cy="21" r=".5"></circle><circle cx="20" cy="8" r=".5"></circle></svg></div>

          <h3>Fast Generation</h3>
          <p>Most dance clips render in <strong>under 30 seconds</strong>, which is quick enough to try several styles on the same photo.</p>
          <div class="modality-chips" aria-hidden="true">

          </div>

          <h3>Up to 4K Output</h3>
          <p>Pick a model tagged for 4K and export at high resolution — enough for a big screen, not just a phone feed.</p>
          <div class="asset-stats" aria-hidden="true">

            <span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="sparkles" class="lucide lucide-sparkles"><path d="M9.937 15.5A2 2 0 0 0 8.5 14.063l-6.135-1.582a.5.5 0 0 1 0-.962L8.5 9.936A2 2 0 0 0 9.937 8.5l1.582-6.135a.5.5 0 0 1 .963 0L14.063 8.5A2 2 0 0 0 15.5 9.937l6.135 1.581a.5.5 0 0 1 0 .964L15.5 14.063a2 2 0 0 0-1.437 1.437l-1.582 6.135a.5.5 0 0 1-.963 0z"></path><path d="M20 3v4"></path><path d="M22 5h-4"></path><path d="M4 17v2"></path><path d="M5 18H3"></path></svg>Ballet</span>

        <article class="bento-card reveal">

  <section id="works" class="examples" aria-labelledby="works-title">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="section-head reveal">
        <h2 id="works-title">What Works, and What It Will Not Do</h2>
        <p>Photo-to-dance is genuinely good at some things and genuinely limited at others. Knowing which is which is the difference between one usable clip and ten wasted generations.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="verdict">
        <article class="verdict-card good reveal">
          <h3><svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="circle-check" class="lucide lucide-circle-check"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"></path></svg>Photos that dance well</h3>
          <ul><li>A clear, well-lit photo with the person facing the camera</li><li>Full-body or three-quarter shots — more of the body means more to animate</li><li>A neutral standing pose, arms not crossed or hidden</li><li>One clear subject against a background that is not busy</li><li>Square or vertical crops if you are posting to Reels, Shorts or TikTok</li></ul>
        </article>
        <article class="verdict-card limit reveal">
          <h3><svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="triangle-alert" class="lucide lucide-triangle-alert"><path d="m21.73 18-8-14a2 2 0 0 0-3.48 0l-8 14A2 2 0 0 0 4 21h16a2 2 0 0 0 1.73-3"></path><path d="M12 9v4"></path><path d="M12 17h.01"></path></svg>Honest limitations</h3>
          <ul><li>It animates a still — it does not copy a specific choreography beat for beat</li><li>Tight head-and-shoulders crops give the model very little body to move</li><li>Heavily obscured faces, motion blur or low light reduce stability</li><li>Hands and fingers are the hardest part of any generated motion</li><li>Clip length is short by design; string several together for a longer routine</li></ul>
        </article>
      </div>
      <figure class="step-media reveal" style="max-width:640px;margin:0 auto 18px;border:1px solid var(--hl-line-02);border-radius:var(--radius-card);overflow:hidden">
        <span class="chrome" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i><b>hailuoai.video/create/image-to-video</b><span class="chrome-tag"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="badge-check" class="lucide lucide-badge-check"><path d="M3.85 8.62a4 4 0 0 1 4.78-4.77 4 4 0 0 1 6.74 0 4 4 0 0 1 4.78 4.78 4 4 0 0 1 0 6.74 4 4 0 0 1-4.77 4.78 4 4 0 0 1-6.75 0 4 4 0 0 1-4.78-4.77 4 4 0 0 1 0-6.76Z"></path><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"></path></svg>Real Hailuo AI editor</span></span>
        <span class="shot"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Hailuo AI model picker filtered by 4K capability, showing Veo 3.1 with a 720P-4K tag" width="736" height="524" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></span>
      </figure>
      <p class="spec-note">Want 4K? Filter the model list by <strong>4K</strong> in the editor &mdash; Veo 3.1 carries a 720P-4K tag. Other models top out lower, so pick the model to match the delivery you need.</p>

        <span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="sparkles" class="lucide lucide-sparkles"><path d="M9.937 15.5A2 2 0 0 0 8.5 14.063l-6.135-1.582a.5.5 0 0 1 0-.962L8.5 9.936A2 2 0 0 0 9.937 8.5l1.582-6.135a.5.5 0 0 1 .963 0L14.063 8.5A2 2 0 0 0 15.5 9.937l6.135 1.581a.5.5 0 0 1 0 .964L15.5 14.063a2 2 0 0 0-1.437 1.437l-1.582 6.135a.5.5 0 0 1-.963 0z"></path><path d="M20 3v4"></path><path d="M22 5h-4"></path><path d="M4 17v2"></path><path d="M5 18H3"></path></svg>Ballet</span>

  <section id="how-to" aria-labelledby="howto-title">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="section-head reveal">
        <h2 id="howto-title">How to Create Your Dance Video</h2>
        <p>Four steps from a still photo to a shareable routine.</p>
      </div>
      <ol class="stepper">
        <li class="step text-only reveal">
          <div class="step-body">
            <div class="step-head"><span class="step-dot" aria-hidden="true">1</span><h3>Upload Your Photo</h3></div>
            <p>Choose a clear photo of a person in a <strong>neutral standing pose</strong>. Full-body shots give the model the most to work with.</p>
          </div>
        </li>
        <li class="step text-only reveal">
          <div class="step-body">
            <div class="step-head"><span class="step-dot" aria-hidden="true">2</span><h3>Name the Dance Style</h3></div>
            <p>Prompt for <strong>K-pop, hip-hop, ballet or street</strong> — or describe the energy and setting and let the model interpret it.</p>
          </div>
        </li>
        <li class="step text-only reveal">
          <div class="step-body">
            <div class="step-head"><span class="step-dot" aria-hidden="true">3</span><h3>Generate</h3></div>
            <p>Most clips are ready in under 30 seconds with smooth, natural movement. Regenerate to try a different style on the same photo.</p>
          </div>
        </li>
        <li class="step text-only reveal">
          <div class="step-body">
            <div class="step-head"><span class="step-dot" aria-hidden="true">4</span><h3>Download &amp; Share</h3></div>
            <p>Export as MP4 — up to 4K on models that support it — and post straight to social.</p>
          </div>
        </li>
      </ol>
    </div>
  </section>
  <section id="faq" aria-labelledby="faq-title">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="section-head reveal">
        <h2 id="faq-title">Frequently Asked Questions</h2>
        <p>What people ask before turning a photo into a dance clip.</p>
      </div>
      <p class="faq-kicker reveal"><svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="circle-check" class="lucide lucide-circle-check"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"></path></svg>Getting a Good Result</p>
      <div class="faq-list">
        <details class="faq-item reveal" open>
          <summary>What photo quality works best?<svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="chevron-down" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></summary>
          <div class="faq-body"><p>Use clear photos with good lighting where the person is <strong>facing the camera</strong>. Full-body shots work better than close-ups, because a head-and-shoulders crop gives the model very little body to animate.</p></div>
        </details>
        <details class="faq-item reveal">
          <summary>What are the steps to use an AI dance generator?<svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="chevron-down" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></summary>
          <div class="faq-body"><p>Four: upload a clear full-body photo, name the dance style you want, generate the clip, then download and share. No choreography or editing knowledge is needed at any step.</p></div>
        </details>
        <details class="faq-item reveal">
          <summary>What are the limitations?<svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="chevron-down" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></summary>
          <div class="faq-body"><p>It animates a still rather than reproducing a specific choreography beat for beat. Tight crops, obscured faces, motion blur and low light all reduce stability, and hands remain the hardest part of any generated motion. Clips are short by design — chain several for a longer routine.</p></div>
        </details>
      </div>
      <p class="faq-kicker reveal"><svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="download" class="lucide lucide-download"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"></path><polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"></polyline><line x1="12" x2="12" y1="15" y2="3"></line></svg>Output &amp; Usage</p>
      <div class="faq-list">
        <details class="faq-item reveal">
          <summary>How long does it take?<svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="chevron-down" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></summary>
          <div class="faq-body"><p>Most dance videos generate in <strong>20–30 seconds</strong>. More complex animations may take up to a minute.</p></div>
        </details>
        <details class="faq-item reveal">

<script>(function () {
  var root = document.currentScript ? document.currentScript.closest('.hlx') : document.querySelector('.hlx');
  if (!root) return;
  var reduced = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  // Example cards: hover previews muted, click plays with sound. One at a time.
  var cards = root.querySelectorAll('.example-card');
  function stop(card) {
    var v = card.querySelector('video');
    card.classList.remove('sound-on');
    if (v) { v.muted = true; v.pause(); }
  }
  cards.forEach(function (card) {
    var video = card.querySelector('video');
    if (!video) return;
    card.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () {
      if (!card.classList.contains('sound-on')) { video.muted = true; video.play().catch(function () {}); }
    });
    card.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () {
      if (!card.classList.contains('sound-on')) video.pause();
    });
    card.addEventListener('click', function () {
      if (card.classList.contains('sound-on')) { stop(card); return; }
      cards.forEach(function (c) { if (c !== card) stop(c); });
      card.classList.add('sound-on');
      video.muted = false;
      video.play().catch(function () {});
    });
  });

  // Reveal on scroll. IntersectionObserver only: the page's own scroller stays
  // in charge, and nothing here reads or writes scroll position.
  var targets = root.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
  if (reduced || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
    targets.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add('is-in'); });
  } else {
    // The host scrolls an inner container, not the document. rootMargin is only
    // applied to the observer's root — never to the clip boxes of intermediate
    // scrollers — so the container has to BE the root, or anything scrolled past
    // it is clipped away and never reported.
    var scroller = null;
    for (var n = root.parentElement; n && n !== document.body; n = n.parentElement) {
      var oy = getComputedStyle(n).overflowY;
      if (oy === 'auto' || oy === 'scroll') { scroller = n; break; }
    }
    // anything already at or above the fold is shown immediately, so landing on
    // an anchor never leaves a trail of invisible content above the viewport
    var foldBottom = scroller ? scroller.getBoundingClientRect().bottom : window.innerHeight;
    targets.forEach(function (el) {
      if (el.getBoundingClientRect().top < foldBottom) el.classList.add('is-in');
    });
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (e) {
        if (!e.isIntersecting) return;
        e.target.classList.add('is-in');
        io.unobserve(e.target);
      });
    // The huge top margin keeps the root open above the viewport, so anything
    // scrolled PAST still fires. Without it a fast flick — or a restored scroll
    // position — can move an element through in under one rendered frame and it
    // stays invisible for good. The bottom margin sets the trigger point.
    }, { root: scroller, rootMargin: '100000px 0px -12% 0px', threshold: 0.01 });
    targets.forEach(function (el) { if (!el.classList.contains('is-in')) io.observe(el); });
  }

  // Count-up figures, driven by visibility rather than scroll offset.
  var counters = root.querySelectorAll('.counter');
  if (counters.length) {
    var run = function (el) {
      var target = parseInt(el.dataset.target, 10);
      if (reduced || !target) { el.textContent = (target || 0).toLocaleString('en-US'); return; }
      var from = Math.round(target * 0.82), t0 = null;
      var step = function (t) {
        if (t0 === null) t0 = t;
        var k = Math.min((t - t0) / 1600, 1);
        var eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - k, 3);
        el.textContent = Math.round(from + (target - from) * eased).toLocaleString('en-US');
        if (k < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
      };
      requestAnimationFrame(step);
    };
    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
      var co = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
        es.forEach(function (e) { if (e.isIntersecting) { run(e.target); co.unobserve(e.target); } });
      }, { threshold: 0.4 });
      counters.forEach(function (el) { co.observe(el); });
    } else { counters.forEach(run); }
  }

  // Gentle float on the hero cards, staggered via CSS animation-delay.
  if (!reduced) {
    root.querySelectorAll('.fan-card').forEach(function (el, i) {
      el.style.animation = 'hlxRise .9s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1) both, hlxFloat ' +
        (4.2 + i * 0.4).toFixed(1) + 's ease-in-out ' + (1.1 + i * 0.4).toFixed(1) + 's infinite';
    });
  }

  // Cursor glow on feature cards.
  root.querySelectorAll('.bento-card').forEach(function (card) {
    card.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
      var r = card.getBoundingClientRect();
      card.style.setProperty('--mx', (e.clientX - r.left) + 'px');
      card.style.setProperty('--my', (e.clientY - r.top) + 'px');
    });
  });
})();</script>

Knowing which is which is the difference between one usable clip and ten wasted generations.\u003c/p\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003cdiv class=\"verdict\"\u003e\n        \u003carticle class=\"verdict-card good reveal\"\u003e\n          \u003ch3\u003e\u003csvg aria-hidden=\"true\" xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" data-lucide=\"circle-check\" class=\"lucide lucide-circle-check\"\u003e\u003ccircle cx=\"12\" cy=\"12\" r=\"10\"\u003e\u003c/circle\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m9 12 2 2 4-4\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003ePhotos that dance well\u003c/h3\u003e\n          \u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003eA clear, well-lit photo with the person facing the camera\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eFull-body or three-quarter shots — more of the body means more to animate\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eA neutral standing pose, arms not crossed or hidden\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eOne clear subject against a background that is not busy\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eSquare or vertical crops if you are posting to Reels, Shorts or TikTok\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\n        \u003c/article\u003e\n        \u003carticle class=\"verdict-card limit reveal\"\u003e\n          \u003ch3\u003e\u003csvg aria-hidden=\"true\" copy a specific choreography beat for beat\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eTight head-and-shoulders crops give the model very little body to move\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eHeavily obscured faces, motion blur or low light reduce stability\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eHands and fingers are the hardest part of any generated motion\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eClip length is short by design; string several together for a longer routine\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\n        \u003c/article\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003cfigure class=\"step-media reveal\" style=\"max-width:640px;margin:0 auto   \u003c/div\u003e\n  \u003c/section\u003e\n  \u003csection id=\"how-to\" aria-labelledby=\"howto-title\"\u003e\n    \u003cdiv class=\"container\"\u003e\n      \u003cdiv class=\"section-head reveal\"\u003e\n        \u003ch2 id=\"howto-title\"\u003eHow to Create Your Dance Video\u003c/h2\u003e\n        \u003cp\u003eFour steps from a still photo to a shareable routine.\u003c/p\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003col class=\"stepper\"\u003e\n        \u003cli class=\"step text-only reveal\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv class=\"step-body\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv class=\"step-head\"\u003e\u003cspan class=\"step-dot\" aria-hidden=\"true\"\u003e1\u003c/span\u003e\u003ch3\u003eUpload Your Photo\u003c/h3\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003cp\u003eChoose a clear photo of a person in a \u003cstrong\u003eneutral standing pose\u003c/strong\u003e. Full-body shots give the model the most to work with.\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/li\u003e\n        \u003cli class=\"step text-only reveal\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv class=\"step-body\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv class=\"step-head\"\u003e\u003cspan class=\"step-dot\" aria-hidden=\"true\"\u003e2\u003c/span\u003e\u003ch3\u003eName the Dance Style\u003c/h3\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003cp\u003ePrompt for \u003cstrong\u003eK-pop, hip-hop, ballet or street\u003c/strong\u003e — or describe the energy and setting and let the model interpret it.\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/li\u003e\n        \u003cli class=\"step text-only reveal\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv class=\"step-body\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv class=\"step-head\"\u003e\u003cspan class=\"step-dot\" aria-hidden=\"true\"\u003e3\u003c/span\u003e\u003ch3\u003eGenerate\u003c/h3\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003cp\u003eMost clips are ready in under 30 seconds with smooth, natural movement. Regenerate to try a different style on the same photo.\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/li\u003e\n        \u003cli class=\"step text-only reveal\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv class=\"step-body\"\u003e\n            \u003cdiv class=\"step-head\"\u003e\u003cspan class=\"step-dot\" aria-hidden=\"true\"\u003e4\u003c/span\u003e\u003ch3\u003eDownload \u0026amp; Share\u003c/h3\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n            \u003cp\u003eExport as MP4 — up to 4K on models that support it — and post straight to social.\u003c/p\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/li\u003e\n      \u003c/ol\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  \u003c/section\u003e\n  \u003csection id=\"faq\" aria-labelledby=\"faq-title\"\u003e\n    \u003cdiv class=\"container\"\u003e\n      \u003cdiv class=\"section-head reveal\"\u003e\n        \u003ch2 id=\"faq-title\"\u003eFrequently Asked Questions\u003c/h2\u003e\n        \u003cp\u003eWhat people ask before turning a photo into a dance clip.\u003c/p\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003cp class=\"faq-kicker reveal\"\u003e\u003csvg aria-hidden=\"true\" xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" data-lucide=\"circle-check\" class=\"lucide lucide-circle-check\"\u003e\u003ccircle cx=\"12\" cy=\"12\" r=\"10\"\u003e\u003c/circle\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m9 12 2 2 4-4\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003eGetting a Good Result\u003c/p\u003e\n      \u003cdiv class=\"faq-list\"\u003e\n        \u003cdetails class=\"faq-item reveal\" open\u003e\n          \u003csummary\u003eWhat photo quality works best?\u003csvg aria-hidden=\"true\" xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" data-lucide=\"chevron-down\" class=\"lucide lucide-chevron-down\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m6 9 6 6 6-6\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/summary\u003e\n          \u003cdiv class=\"faq-body\"\u003e\u003cp\u003eUse clear photos with good lighting where the person is \u003cstrong\u003efacing the camera\u003c/strong\u003e. Full-body shots work better than close-ups, because a head-and-shoulders crop gives the model very little body to animate.\u003c/p\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/details\u003e\n        \u003cdetails class=\"faq-item reveal\"\u003e\n          \u003csummary\u003eWhat are the steps to use an AI dance generator?\u003csvg aria-hidden=\"true\" xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" data-lucide=\"chevron-down\" class=\"lucide lucide-chevron-down\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m6 9 6 6 6-6\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/summary\u003e\n          \u003cdiv class=\"faq-body\"\u003e\u003cp\u003eFour: upload a clear full-body photo, name the dance style you want, generate the clip, then download and share. No choreography or editing knowledge is needed at any step.\u003c/p\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/details\u003e\n        \u003cdetails class=\"faq-item reveal\"\u003e\n          \u003csummary\u003eWhat are the limitations?\u003csvg aria-hidden=\"true\" xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" data-lucide=\"chevron-down\" class=\"lucide lucide-chevron-down\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m6 9 6 6 6-6\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/summary\u003e\n          \u003cdiv class=\"faq-body\"\u003e\u003cp\u003eIt animates a still rather than reproducing a specific choreography beat for beat. Tight crops, obscured faces, motion blur and low light all reduce stability, and hands remain the hardest part of any generated motion. The more you promote, the more you earn.\\n\\nExample: If you refer 10 Pro monthly subscribers and 20 Unlimited yearly subscribers, you'll earn:\\n(10×$34.99 + 20×$1139.88) × 95% × 10% = $2,199\\n\\n- $34.99 is the Pro Monthly Plan price, $1139.88 is the Unlimited Yearly Plan price\\n- 95% represents the actual amount paid by referred users after their 5% discount\\n- 10% is your commission rate\",\"affiliate_faq_answer_4\":\"Our commission structure is designed to benefit both affiliates and new customers:\\n- You receive a 10% commission on each subscription generated through your referral link\\n- New users who sign up through your link enjoy a 5% discount on their first order\\n- The commission is calculated based on the discounted amount paid by the referred customer\",\"affiliate_faq_answer_5\":\"You can track your earnings on the affiliate dashboard. Commissions become available for withdrawal 30 days after your referred customer makes a payment.
